subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

When I / was / young, I / play hockey.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "play hockey."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence** "****When I was young, I play hockey****"** lies in the use of the verb "play" with the duration of time.
 
• The error in the sentence is related to the verb tense. 
 
• The past tense **"played"** is the appropriate form to indicate that the action (playing hockey) occurred in the past.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence:* When I was young, I **played hockey**__. *
